name: caution_flee_recall
description: #557 (owner): 1 = C: a fleeing Borg reads Word of Recall as its escape (after #539's stairs and ranged checks), and Recall counts as an easy escape for the #503/#530 stand tests; 0 = only on a level swamped by breeders (caution_flee_recall_breeders) or when chased by several monsters (caution_flee_recall_chasers), else the flight walks.

name: caution_flee_recall_breeders
description: #557: with caution_flee_recall 0, this many breeders known on the level make Word of Recall an escape again; 0 = never for breeders.

name: caution_flee_recall_chasers

name: caution_flee_recall_chase_distance

name: caution_flee_recall_gate_below_depth
description: #557 (owner): a ceiling. With caution_flee_recall 1, a flight at a depth shallower than this (2 = DL1 only) reads Word of Recall only with the breeder or chaser exception of caution_flee_recall 0, and Recall there is no easy escape in the stand tests; the stairs are a short walk. 0 = off (C at every depth); 1 is off too (the town never asks).

name: caution_flee_recall_danger_percent
description: #587 (owner): where the depth gate or caution_flee_recall 0 holds a flight's Word of Recall back, the danger here at or above this percent of the current HP allows it (with the breeder and chaser exceptions); only the flight's read, not the stand tests. 0 = off; at the shipped gate (1, off) and caution_flee_recall 1 nothing is held back, so it acts only with the gate on or caution_flee_recall 0.

name: caution_scary_ranged_no_stairs
description: #539 (owner): 1 = with no staircase the Borg can walk to, a scary level lets borg_attack target an awake monster in view at range (the best ranged attack), and Word of Recall and Phase Door wait while there is one (none next to the Borg) and the attack planner has something to shoot or throw at it; 0 = off.

name: town_recall_reserve
description: #557: the live town planner (the capability model, and borg_town_utility.rs's need model) values this many Word of Recall as a requirement at the full trip weight each, at any depth (the walk a scroll saves is always worth less than that), so a shallow Borg buys and carries one; 0 = off (Recall valued only as the walk it saves, which at DL1-3 never beats saving gold).

name: town_recall_value_percent
description: #557 (owner): the town planner values a Word of Recall at this percent of the walk it saves (both the capability model and borg_town_utility.rs's need model); 100 = as computed; higher makes a shallow Borg buy and keep one.

name: prepared_recall_depth
description: #557 (owner): a descent to this depth or deeper needs one Word of Recall carried (C's "1 recall", from DL5); lower moves it shallower; 0 = never. It only gates descents: it buys nothing.

name: town_gold_reserve
description: #493: gold of the purse at arrival the live town planner keeps outside the urgent needs (the larger of this and town_gold_reserve_percent); the visit's sale proceeds are spendable on top of it.

name: town_gold_reserve_percent
description: #493: percent of the purse at arrival the live town planner keeps outside the urgent needs (the larger of this and town_gold_reserve); the visit's sale proceeds are spendable on top of it.

name: town_fear_cure_count
description: #516: while the character is not afraid, fear cures (Potion of Boldness, CURE:AFRAID) are valued linearly up to this many in the pack and not beyond (each of the first ones is worth more than on the curve, a further one nothing); 0 = the diminishing curve (the planner kept buying Boldness: 35 bought, 7 drunk on 18 games).

name: town_heal_curve_scale_percent
description: #491: stretches the live town planner's diminishing healing curve: weight and demand scale together, keeping the first HP's value and moving the half-value point to this percent of today's (100 = today).

name: town_phase_curve_scale_percent
description: #682 (owner): stretches the live town planner's Phase Door curve, as town_heal_curve_scale_percent does healing's: weight and demand scale together (100 = today). Per class with town_phase_curve_scale_percent@<class> or the class files.

name: town_oil_curve_scale_percent
description: #682 (owner): weights a flask of oil's thrown damage in the live town planner (100 = today), so a class buys more or fewer flasks to throw; flasks kept as lantern fuel are not changed. Per class with town_oil_curve_scale_percent@<class> or the class files.

name: town_heal_speed_percent
description: #491: healing speed. A HEAL_HP use that restores at least this percent of max HP counts its HP in full in the live town planner's healing and healing reserve; a smaller one counts heal x heal / (this percent of max HP) (0 = HP alone). With town_heal_reserve_real_hp = 1 speed weights only the healing curve; with 0 also the reserve.

name: town_heal_reserve_hp_percent
description: #491: healing, as a percent of max HP, the live town planner values linearly at the curve's first-HP value on top of the curve; bought first, never sold below (0 = off).

name: town_heal_reserve_real_hp
description: #487: 1 = the healing reserve counts the real HP a potion restores; town_heal_speed_percent then weights only the healing curve (which kind is worth more), not how many potions fill the reserve; 0 = speed-weighted HP (#491 as first shipped).

name: town_digger_min_gold
description: #487: below this much gold the live town planner values no digging (a Shovel only clears rubble, which a weapon also digs); 0 = off.

name: town_missiles_percent
description: #666 (owner): the town plan's reserve of shots for the class's launcher, in percent of borg_town_w_ranger_missiles, for any class (set per class by shooting skill in harness/borg_<class>.txt). -1 = C: the Ranger's reserve only.

name: town_missiles_other_ranged_percent
description: #666 (owner): "projectile buying is more important if they cannot get flasks of oil or wands". With at least 5 flasks of oil and attack-wand charges (Magic Missile, Stinking Cloud) in the pack, the reserve of shots weighs this percent. 100 = no change.

name: town_devices_percent
description: #666 (owner): a wand, rod or staff is worth this percent of what it supplies in the town plan (set per class by device skill in harness/borg_<class>.txt). 100 = as computed.

name: caution_rising_explore_ticks
description: #483: while rising to town, Borg ticks (one per think; restarted on each new level) during which a descent other than a desperate one is held so the Borg explores for an up staircase; 0 = off (C's behaviour).

name: caution_rising_descend_danger_tenths
description: #483: while rising, danger here above avoidance x this / 10 lets a descent through again.

name: caution_stair_low_level
description: Controls stair low level.

name: caution_stair_danger_divisor
description: Controls stair danger divisor.

name: caution_cornered
description: #504: 1 = cornered (no Phase Door, teleport or escape, a monster near, danger at or above the HP) the Borg uses every buff it has (fear cure, Speed, Heroism, Berserk Strength, Blessing) regardless of their usual danger windows, reads Monster Confusion against an adjacent big monster, and a melee class neither retreats nor backs away; 0 = off.

name: caution_cornered_danger_tenths
description: #504: cornered when danger here x 10 >= current HP x this (10 = danger at or above the HP).

name: caution_cornered_radius
description: #504: cornered only with a known monster within this many grids (a fight is on).

name: caution_breeder_boost_danger_tenths
description: #504 (owner): standing against breeders with no easy escape, danger here at or above the HP x this / 10 makes the Borg use the cornered boosts (fear cure, Speed, Heroism, Berserk Strength, Blessing); 0 = off.

name: caution_cornered_spell_fail
description: #504: cornered, a buff spell (Haste Self, Heroism, Berserk Strength, Bless) is cast only at or below this failure percent, so a failing cast is not retried turn after turn under fire.

name: caution_cornered_big_level_margin
description: #504: an adjacent monster is big (Monster Confusion) when unique or its level exceeds the Borg's by more than this.

name: caution_breeder_flee_max_level
description: Controls breeder flee max level.

name: caution_breeder_fight
description: #503: 1 = with breeders on the level and no easy escape the Borg stands and fights (no breeder flee, no breeder scary level, no breeder 'no recall' flee), and below clevel 10 it hunts breeders while few (caution_breeder_hunt_max_count, per class since #558); 0 = off (C's behaviour), which also turns off recover_breeder_hunt_hp_percent and danger_hunt_breeder_no_acid_fear.

name: caution_breeder_easy_escape_steps
description: #503: a free staircase within this many grids (the engine's distance) is an easy escape from breeders (as is a Phase Door, teleport, Teleport Level, escape or Word of Recall).

name: caution_breeder_stand_radius
description: #503: standing against breeders, with a breeder within this many grids and no other known monster within danger_monster_max_distance (on the larger axis distance, borg_danger's reach), the Borg neither retreats nor backs away from their danger (being surrounded still moves it).

name: caution_scary_named_monsters
description: #503: 1 = the C Borg's hard-coded scary monsters by character level (squint-eyed rogue, Grip, Fang, small kobold, soldier, cutpurse, ..., Bullroarer, breeders, cave spider, ..., hounds, ancient dragons, Beorn, Dread) and the low-level door scares mark the level scary (leave and flee) until a new level; 0 = off (the resist-based scares stay). The data file's ignore lines (#621) don't depend on it.

name: caution_town_never_scary
description: #604 (owner): 1 = in town no monster makes the level scary (the named list, the damage rule, the resist scares): the Borg meets town monsters by its danger rules instead of fleeing to DL1; 0 = C.

name: caution_town_scary_levels_less
description: #622 (owner): a town monster (race level 0) on the data-file scary list (borg_scary_list; not the compiled C list) is scary for this many fewer character levels: clevel <= listed level - this. The list's order stays; 11 or more ends the town's list scares at once (the damage rule and resist scares still apply); 0 = the list as it is.

name: caution_town_flee_no_worse
description: #647: 1 = in town, while the level is scary or the Borg flees or leaves, the flow refuses no grid at most as dangerous as the Borg's own (its fear is at least the danger here): a low-level Borg next to a filthy street urchin found every path to the stairs refused and twitched for 70,000 turns. 0 = C (the flow's fear alone).

name: caution_scary_damage_percent
description: #505: a monster on the level is scary (leave and flee, as the named list) when one character turn of its melee (the average of its blows' random_value, base + dice + level bonus as randcalc AVERAGE, times its moves per character turn) takes at least this percent of max HP (owner: scary is a monster that can one- or two-shot you). Spells are not counted. 0 = off.

name: caution_scary_stand
description: #530: 1 = in the dungeon a monster that never moves is never scary, and a scary level is fled only while the escape is real: a free staircase within caution_breeder_easy_escape_steps or an escape item, or no scary monster awake and at least as fast as the character; otherwise the Borg stands and fights (the scare's leave and flee are withdrawn). 0 = C (flee every scary level).

name: caution_scary_latch
description: #515: with caution_scary_stand, 1 = the C latch: a scary level stays scary until a new level; 0 = the flag is re-checked each scan of the known monsters, and when no scary monster remains the level stops being scary and the goals the scare set (leave, flee, flee to town) are withdrawn. Door scares stay latched.

name: caution_stairs_leave_on_monster
description: #614: 1 = in the dungeon, a Borg standing on a staircase that still needs to recover (HP or SP below the maximum) takes the stairs as soon as a monster threatens it (danger here at least caution_stairs_leave_danger_percent of the current HP), instead of fighting or reading an escape; never in town (review of #616: the town's down staircase made it dive into DL1); 0 = C.

name: caution_stairs_leave_danger_percent
description: #614 (review of #616): with caution_stairs_leave_on_monster, the danger here, as a percent of the current HP, that counts as a monster threatening (at least 1): any danger above 0 fired at danger 1, a distant or harmless monster.

name: caution_stairs_leave_down
description: #614 (review of #616): with caution_stairs_leave_on_monster, 1 = take the staircase the Borg stands on, up or down (the owner: climb up/down); 0 = an up staircase only (a down one goes deeper).

name: caution_scary_unlatch_kill
description: #590 (owner): with caution_scary_stand (the scary flag is decided after each scan), 1 = the level's scary flag clears once no scary monster is known and the last one known was killed (a monster of a race that made the level scary died since a scan last found one known), with caution_scary_latch on or off; forgetting the monster is not enough (it has not left the level). 0 = the latch decides (1: never on the level; 0: whenever none is known).

name: caution_scary_unlatch_calmed
description: #593 (owner): with caution_scary_stand, 1 = the level's scary flag clears once no scary monster is known and a named-list or damage-rule scary monster is known hurt or afraid in this scan (caution_scary_hurt_percent, caution_scary_afraid; resist-based scares are never calmed), or one was killed, with caution_scary_latch on or off; forgetting the monster is not enough. Only a race that made the level scary counts (#590's record): a monster hurt or afraid from first sight never made it scary. 0 = off.

name: caution_scary_hurt_percent
description: #539: a named-list or damage-rule scary monster that has lost at least this percent of its HP (kill.injury, from the health bar) makes nothing scary; resist-based and door scares are not affected. With caution_scary_latch 0 a level whose scary monsters are all hurt stops being scary. 0 = off (C).

name: caution_scary_afraid
description: #539: 1 = a named-list or damage-rule scary monster that is afraid (kill.afraid) makes nothing scary; resist-based and door scares are not affected. 0 = C.

name: caution_flee_known_down_stairs
description: #544 (A), narrowed in #548: 1 = fleeing (or the level scary) with no free up staircase known, the Borg walks to a known down staircase with the desperate flow (danger ignored, monster grids routed around), only when cornered (caution_flee_known_down_cornered) and within caution_flee_known_down_max_cost grids of flow; 0 = off (C's behaviour). Keeping the stairs through the stuck jumpstart is caution_jumpstart_keep_stairs.

name: caution_flee_known_down_cornered
description: #548: with caution_flee_known_down_stairs, 1 = only when cornered: a known monster that can move is adjacent (distance 1, diagonals included; #504 uses caution_cornered_radius), no Phase Door, teleport, Teleport Level or escape in the pack (items; spells are not counted), and the danger here at or above the HP or the Borg surrounded; 0 = any flight (#545 as merged: it fired on 13 of 18 classes-18 games, up to 721 times).

name: caution_flee_known_down_max_cost
description: #548: with caution_flee_known_down_stairs, the known down staircase is taken only within this many steps of flow (the flow's depth from the staircases: the walk around walls, not the straight-line distance); 0 = any distance (#545 as merged).

name: caution_jumpstart_keep_stairs
description: #548 (K of #544, split from caution_flee_known_down_stairs): 1 = the stuck jumpstart (bravery boost 3) keeps the known up and down staircases instead of forgetting them; 0 = C (forgets them). Usually wanted with caution_flee_known_down_stairs: in the worm room (priest-1055640847) the narrowed flight escapes only with it. Alone it did not save that game (still dead at turn 91,153).

name: caution_twitch_avoid_lava
description: #597: 1 = the twitch's random step (borg_twitchy, borg_flow_misc.rs) never chooses lava without fire immunity (100 + 1d100 fire damage per step); if every direction is wall or lava the Borg rests. 0 = C (only walls are refused).

name: caution_stair_parked_fallback
description: #597: 1 = a stair flow that finds a monster marked on every known staircase of its kind (enqueue_stairs, borg_flow_stairs.rs) flows to them anyway, so the only known staircase is never refused for a monster on it, harmless or long gone. 0 = C (a parked staircase is skipped).

name: caution_breeder_exit
description: #544 (B): 1 = only breeders near, one adjacent, and danger here at or above the HP or surrounded: the Borg walks with the desperate flow to the nearest known chokepoint (a grid whose passable known neighbours form at least two separate groups: a corridor or doorway; unknown grids count as walls) at least caution_breeder_exit_distance grids from every known breeder; 0 = off.

name: caution_breeder_exit_distance
description: #544 (B): an exit grid is at least this many grids (the engine's distance) from every known breeder.

name: caution_breeder_avoid
description: #556: 1 = every grid a breeder is seen on (a moving breeder leaves a trail of marks, one per grid) is remembered for caution_breeder_avoid_turns; every flow but a kill flow (the stair and flee flows, exploration, items, the breeder exit) treats a grid within caution_breeder_avoid_radius of one as impassable, except the grids next to the Borg (its first step), so it neither walks into a colony nor back into one it lost from view; and a Phase Door landing grid there counts as scary. 0 = off (C's behaviour).

name: caution_breeder_avoid_radius
description: #556: with caution_breeder_avoid, a grid within this many grids (the engine's distance) of a remembered breeder is avoided; 0 = only the breeder's own grid.

name: caution_breeder_avoid_turns
description: #556: with caution_breeder_avoid, a breeder's grid is remembered this many Borg turns (`time.now`, one per think) after the breeder was last known there.

name: caution_breeder_avoid_fight_through
description: #556 (owner 2026-11-19: "fallback to fight our way out"): with caution_breeder_avoid, 1 = a flight whose stair flow finds no route around the remembered breeders takes the plain route through them, and for caution_breeder_through_turns after, retreat and back-away stand down while the danger here is below the HP (the Borg kills what blocks the way and goes on); 0 = no route, the flight looks elsewhere.

name: caution_breeder_through_turns
description: #556: with caution_breeder_avoid_fight_through, retreat and back-away stand down this many Borg turns after the flight last took the route through the breeders (the flow is recomputed after every attack).

name: caution_breeder_stuck_turns
description: #556: with caution_breeder_avoid, when the Borg is stuck (the dungeon think reaches its bravery boosts) while remembered breeders block its flows, the marks are ignored for this many Borg turns, so it can fight its way out instead of staying boxed in; 0 = never (the marks hold even when stuck).

name: caution_breeder_stoppable
description: #556 (owner 2026-11-19: "kill them first and only escape if it is not possible"): 1 = on a level with breeders the Borg stands and hunts them (breeder_stand and breeder_hunt, at any count and character level, escape items or not) while the breeding can be stopped: the known breeders' expected births a turn (the engine's 1 in 8k while k < 4, monster speed against the character's), times caution_breeder_stoppable_births_percent, below the Borg's kills a turn (every attack it has: the attack planner's dry run, borg_attack_estimate, and the kills of the attack it would choose, for each monster hit its true damage over that monster's HP at most 1; the random state is restored after the dry run). A think is judged only when the planner has something to attack. With the danger where it stands at or above the HP it does not stand that think. While no staircase is known it fights on even then (a flight with nowhere to go). Once the breeding outpaces the kills, the level is lost to them until a new one, and the breeder flees act (with caution_breeder_avoid, the flight avoids the colony). 0 = #503's stand (no easy escape) and #558's hunt (caution_breeder_hunt_max_count, below clevel 10).

name: caution_breeder_stoppable_births_percent
description: #556: with caution_breeder_stoppable, the expected births a turn are weighed by this percent against the kills a turn (200 = the Borg must kill twice as fast as they breed: it walks between them and does not see them all).

name: caution_breeder_stoppable_confirm
description: #556: with caution_breeder_stoppable, the level is lost to the breeders only after the breeding outpaced the kills on this many judged thinks in a row (a think is judged only when the attack planner has something to attack).

name: caution_stair_scum_threat
description: #549: 1 = after fleeing town, no stair scum (grabbing DL1 items near the stairs before going back up) while the level is scary, the danger here is above caution_stair_scum_danger, or the HP is below the maximum: the Borg goes straight back up (and the scum's own GOAL_TAKE flow is cancelled). The HP condition is the broad one: any injury stops the scum; 0 = off (C's behaviour).

name: caution_stair_scum_danger
description: #549: with caution_stair_scum_threat, a danger here above this stops the stair scum.

name: caution_rising_hold_flee_descent
description: #557: 1 = while rising (a return trip on foot) in the dungeon, a flight takes no down staircase (stair_more, the both-stairs flee flow, the down-stairs flee flow) unless the danger here is at or above the HP; with birth_connect_stairs each such flight lands on DL+1's up staircase and the climb restarts on a fresh level; 0 = off (C's behaviour).

name: caution_breeder_hunt_max_count
description: #503, #558: below clevel 10 the Borg hunts breeders while at most this many are known on the level (with caution_breeder_fight); a class value per class (the class files), 0 = that class does not hunt. Before #558 only Warriors, Paladins, Rogues and Blackguards hunted.

name: recover_breeder_hunt_hp_percent
description: #558 (owner): when a rest is due, HP is at least this percent of max HP and the Borg is fit to hunt breeders now (the hunt applies: caution_breeder_fight on and caution_breeder_hunt_max_count; the Borg is not ignoring the breeders, fleeing or leaving, and no scary monster is on the level; a Mage or Necromancer has half its mana; it is not hungry, confused, hallucinating, afraid or stunned; a known breeder passes the hunt walk's danger test, but not its leash to the stairs or reachability), the Borg does not rest (breeders multiply while it rests) and hunts them first. The HP rest is skipped only when it is due and those hold; the mana rest is skipped whenever they hold. For an acid breeder (a worm mass) the danger test passes only with danger_hunt_breeder_no_acid_fear on; 0 = off (C's rest).

name: recover_rest_breeders
description: #644 (owner): 1 = in the dungeon, while any breeder is known on the level, no rod, HP/SP or mana rest: the Borg hunts the breeders when #558's hunt applies, otherwise leaves the level; kept when confused, blind, hallucinating or stunned. 0 = rest as C.

name: escape_phase_adjacent_only
description: #539 (owner): 1 = no Phase Door unless an awake monster is next to the Borg or one in view has a ranged attack ("do not phase door when a monster is still distant"); 0 = off (C's behaviour).

name: escape_phase_adjacent_rule
description: #584 (owner): 1 = at every Phase Door site (docs/PHASE-DOOR.md), if the Borg can Phase Door, no Phase Door unless an awake enemy is on an adjacent square and the fight is judged lost (escape_phase_lost_test). The rule only refuses the Phase Door: the escape levels go on with their other escapes, and if none acts the Borg attacks (its best attack by its own ranking; with no enemy adjacent only a ranged one) or, with an awake monster in view, boosts (Speed first, then Heroism, Berserk Strength, Bless; else borg_defend's resistances, Protection from Evil, shields and staves). Decided once per think; #539's escape_phase_adjacent_only check is skipped while it is on. 0 = each site's own check (C, #539).

name: escape_phase_lost_danger_percent
description: #584: with escape_phase_adjacent_rule, an adjacent fight is judged lost (Phase Door allowed) when escape_phase_lost_test is 0: the danger where the Borg stands at or above this percent of the current HP; 100 = the Borg could die this turn.

name: escape_phase_lost_mana
description: #625 (owner): with escape_phase_adjacent_rule on and escape_phase_lost_test 1 or 2, 1 = the fight test weighs the chosen attack's true damage by its success chance (a spell's fail rate, a device's activation failure) and uses it only for the casts the current mana pays for, all of it (owner: the escape reserve is not set aside; a wand: its charges; a rod: one), then the best other attack that needs no mana, or melee; 0 = the chosen attack at full damage every turn (#612).

name: escape_phase_lost_test
description: #584 (owner): with escape_phase_adjacent_rule, how an adjacent fight is judged lost (Phase Door allowed): 0 = the danger where the Borg stands at or above escape_phase_lost_danger_percent of the HP; 1 = the fight compared: killing the adjacent awake monsters one after another (their HP left) takes more turns than the danger where it stands needs to kill the Borg; its damage a turn is the larger of its melee and the true damage of the attack it would choose now, of any kind (a Mage casts next to an enemy); 2 = as 1, and the mean danger of the sampled landing grids is below the danger here.

name: escape_fox_form
description: #551: 1 = a Druid about to take a flight step (GOAL_FLEE) at least escape_fox_form_min_steps from its goal casts Fox Form (double movement, Free Action) first, and keeps the shape while the flight lasts: an item or a spell answers the game's "Change back and ...?" with y (same command, no extra energy). 0 = C (never cast; any shape is reverted at once).

name: escape_fox_form_fail
description: #551: with escape_fox_form, the highest Fox Form fail rate at which it is cast (Fox Form: level 1, 20% base fail).

name: escape_fox_form_min_steps
description: #551: with escape_fox_form, the fewest flow steps left to the flight's goal for which the cast (one turn) is worth it.

name: escape_fox_form_speed
description: #551: with escape_fox_form, the speed a fox's flight is worth: borg_danger while a fox (it only moves), and the stand decision's pursuer test while a fox (MOVES[1] halves a step's energy: +10 at normal speed).

name: escape_fox_form_stand_speed
description: #551 (review of #594): with escape_fox_form, the speed the stand decision's pursuer test counts for a Druid that is not yet a fox but can cast Fox Form (it will at its first flight step): more speed, fewer pursuers, more flights. 0 = only a fox counts.

name: escape_fox_form_town
description: #620 (owner): 1 = a Druid at most escape_fox_form_town_max_level, about to take a step of a walk in town (to a shop, home, a staircase, or a flight; not a kill or a take) at least escape_fox_form_town_min_steps from its goal, casts Fox Form (double movement) if its fail rate is at most escape_fox_form_fail, keeps it while the walk lasts, and changes back at the shop door (the game shuts it on a fox) or before a blow. 0 = C (never in town).

name: escape_fox_form_town_max_level
description: #620: with escape_fox_form_town, the highest character level that casts Fox Form for a walk in town (the manual's CL1-20 escape, 14-class-playbooks.md:453).

name: escape_fox_form_town_min_steps
description: #620: with escape_fox_form_town, the fewest flow steps left to the walk's goal for which the cast (one turn, and its mana) is worth it.

name: recover_rest_arms_see_invis
description: #516: 1 = C: a rest stamps the see-invisible clock as recent, which arms the Detect Invisible defence after every rest; 0 = a rest leaves it alone (only an unseen attack arms it). The same clock gates the Light Beam defence (skipped while recent) and the removal of regional fear (kept while recent), so at 0 both can act after a rest where C did not. 187 reads on 18 games, 171 with no unseen monster on the level.

name: recover_rest_monster_turns
description: #615 rule a (owner): no rest (rod, HP/SP, mana) while an awake monster that can move was known within recover_rest_monster_distance in the last this many game turns on this level; a monster that comes into view would break the rest, and one that leaves the screen may come back. Kept when impaired (confused, blind, hallucinating, stunned, afraid); the clock clears when the monster that set it dies. 0 = off (C).

name: recover_rest_monster_distance
description: #615 rule a: with recover_rest_monster_turns, how near an awake monster must be (the engine's distance).

name: recover_rest_reach_stairs
description: #614: a Borg on a flight to a staircase (GOAL_FLEE) at most this many flow steps away does not rest (rod, HP or mana) until it stands on the staircase; potions and cures are not rests; a farther staircase is a long walk, not a commitment. 0 = C (the low-level mana rest stopped a flight 11 steps short of the stairs).

name: recover_rest_reach_stairs_memory
description: #614 (review of #616): with recover_rest_reach_stairs, how long after its last flight step, on the same level, a flight that is still on (fleeing, leaving or a scary level) keeps the Borg committed to its staircase when the flow goal was wiped (a new monster wipes it for a think).
